task: Photorealistic YouTube podcast thumbnail of the 8 podcast hosts, built from each host's own reference photo (used with their consent)
reference_images: 8 separate photos, one per host (A-H). Use only the face and identity; ignore backgrounds, UI overlays, captions and clothing in the references

rules: Exactly 8 people, one per reference, no duplicates, no merged faces
Keep each person's face shape, skin tone, hairstyle, facial hair and glasses
Do not beautify, slim, age or change ethnicity

people.looks: young man, short brown curly hair, thin round wire glasses, light goatee
man, dense black curly hair, light blue-grey eyes, thick dark eyebrows, thin silver chain
man, very short dark hair, full dark beard, broad face
people.outfit: khaki/beige military-style shirt over white t-shirt

people.looks: young man, very short dark buzz cut, thin goatee and moustache
people.expression: smirk, one eyebrow raised, looking at camera

people.looks: young woman, long straight dark hair with face-framing layers, brown eyes
young woman, dark hair slicked back into a braid, wide smile
young man, dark textured fringe with short faded sides, small ear stud, thin moustache
people.outfit: white knit open-collar shirt (buttoned up) or black t-shirt

people.looks: young woman, dark hair slicked back with center part, clear safety glasses
people.expression: shouting, mouth wide open, one hand raised

composition.framing: tight and crowded, shoulder to shoulder, faces fill ~85% of the frame
composition.back_row: A, B, C, D slightly higher and smaller, heads visible between front-row heads
composition.front_row: E, F, G, H larger and closer to camera, cropped at chest
composition.title_area: keep bottom-center (approx. x 610-1310, y 905-1055) clean for a title added later

props: black over-ear studio headphones on all 8; four black podcast microphones on boom arms in front of the front row
background: vivid orange-to-red gradient, blurred warm studio bokeh, rough purple paint-stroke accents, light vignette
lighting: bright key light on faces, orange and magenta rim light, sharp eyes
style: Israeli comedy podcast thumbnail, high saturation, punchy contrast, photorealistic, realistic skin texture
negative_prompt: text, letters, logos, watermark, UI elements, speech bubble, distorted faces, merged faces, duplicated people, extra or missing people, extra fingers, nudity, shirtless, cleavage, lingerie, blurry, cut-out collage look
